name: neno-safari
description: Mobile-friendly Tanzanian Swahili vocabulary word search game.

scripts.test: node ./scripts/validate-content.mjs && node ./scripts/test-puzzle-engine.mjs && node ./scripts/test-ui-utils.mjs && node ./scripts/test-storage.mjs && node ./scripts/test-review-scheduler.mjs && node ./scripts/test-haptics.mjs && node ./scripts/test-offline-packs.mjs && node ./scripts/test-app-boot.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run mobile:build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:add: npm run mobile:build && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
